_meta.purpose: The content-funnel config for every empire link-in-bio hub: where each hub sends people. Consumed by the shared content-hub renderer (BUSINESSES/empire-shared/content-hub).
_meta.strategy: Priority ladder, in render order: (1) LATEST EPISODE — auto-fetched from the YouTube channel's public RSS via /api/latest-episode; (2) YOUTUBE — the loudest slot, because that is where the view credit + algorithm live; (3) LISTEN — the streaming/monetized-listening row; (4) RESOURCES — blog / guides / lead magnets.

contract.verified: true ONLY when the URL/channel was resolved live and confirmed ours. The renderer emits NOTHING for verified:false — never a dead or fabricated destination.
contract.channel_id: A real YouTube channel id (UC + 22 chars). Required for latest-episode auto-fetch. The RSS feed does NOT accept @handles. If only a handle is known, the /api/latest-episode function resolves it, but a stored channel_id is faster and more reliable.
contract.listen platforms: Keys must match the resolver matrix in ../deep-links/platforms.json: spotify, apple_podcasts, youtube_music, amazon_music, deezer. Each ships its plain web URL always; native-app handoff fires only inside a detected in-app browser and only for VERIFIED/PARTIAL platforms.
